summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs, invoked via npm's preinstall lifecycle hook) detects the installer's platform and architecture, downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it into a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then invokes that Bun binary against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with obfuscator.io-style transformations: a shuffled string array with runtime rotation (WV8StW/MmgoCP), a large mixed numeric/character constant table, hex-prefixed random identifiers, and a custom-alphabet string decoder (hc1jfK9). Because the payload only executes under the dropped Bun runtime, its behavior is not observable to Node-based tooling that inspects the package. The advertised purpose of the package is a CLI for building OREST inputs; fetching an alternate runtime at install time to run an obfuscated bundled blob has no relation to that stated function. Installing this package causes arbitrary author-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine at install time under a runtime whose behavior is opaque to Node-based analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
